description: This file defines the EmployeeTimeReportController class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component named 'employee-time-report' in its preRender method.

classes.name: EmployeeTimeReportController
classes.description: Controller handling the employee time report view, extending AbstractVueController and setting up the Vue component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view by creating and assigning a Vue component for the employee time report.
